entries.official_publisher: Government of Western Australia (Department of Mines, Industry Regulation and Safety — Consumer Protection, Bond Administrator)
entries.direct_data_url: wa-rental-bond.zip (via the National Housing Data Exchange mirror of the official WA Government release)
entries.access_method: direct file_download, no bot protection observed
entries.source_grain: RAW individual bond lodgement/disposal records, NOT pre-aggregated medians — 'Bonds By Postcode Summary', 'Monthly Bond Lodgement Summary' (locality, postcode, weekly rent per lodgement), 'Monthly Bond Disposal Summary'
entries.property_type_detail: not specified in the lodgement record — would need to be inferred or left NULL
entries.bedroom_detail: not specified in the lodgement record
entries.price_rent_definition: weekly rent as declared at bond lodgement
entries.transaction_level_or_aggregate: transaction-level (individual bond lodgements) — this project's adapter would need to compute its own postcode-level medians and apply the same sample_size_confidence thresholds already used elsewhere
entries.automation_suitability: medium — data itself is free and unrestricted, but requires building genuine aggregation logic (median-from-raw-lodgements) rather than reading a pre-computed figure, a materially larger adapter-build task than QLD/SA/VIC
entries.access_restrictions: none found on the data itself
entries.likely_branch_mart_size_mb_estimate: 10-20 (postcode grain only — no suburb grain in the raw source without further address-level geocoding, which is out of scope)
entries.reason: Genuinely free (CC BY 4.0) but structurally different from every other jurisdiction's rent source in this sprint — raw lodgement records requiring in-house median computation, not a source-provided aggregate. File structure not yet downloaded/inspected; deferred to the Workstream 6 adapter build.
